Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. It can only digivolve into a [Reptile] trait card or a card with both the [Dragonkin] and [LIBERATOR] traits.
Card Q&A.q: If I would use this card's  effect to digivolve my Digimon, can it digivolve into a [Reptile] trait Digimon card or a Digimon card with just the [Dragonkin] trait or [LIBERATOR] trait?

Effect: [Main] You may play 1 [Elizamon] or [Owen Dreadnought] from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Your Turn] When any of your [Owen Dreadnought]s suspend, ＜Delay＞.

・1 of your [Reptile] or [Dragonkin] trait Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with the [Reptile] or [Dragonkin] trait and the [LIBERATOR] trait in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 3.
